Priya (AE): Hey team, new POC with a regulated payments provider. Requirements: Private deployment in eu-west-1 + ap-southeast-1, strict per-region /32 allowlist only, zero peering, no TGW. They asked if Redwood can be the source IP (i.e., we own static egress IPs) and what the SLA/pricing impact is.
Nate (NetEng): Short answer: we can, but only as a reserved/dedicated egress add-on. We assign a fixed /32 per connector instance. Without a reserved contract, egress comes from shared pools which are too broad for /32 allowlisting.
Priya (AE): Customer explicitly said "we will not modify our firewall to accept large cloud ranges". They want our exact IPs to add to point-in-time policy.
Hannah (Solutions): Operational pattern: deploy one connector per region with an assigned EIP. Use region-specific CNAMEs (api.customer-eu -> eu-west-1 connector IP). For failover, Route53 health checks can route to the other region but that would change source IP unless they allow cross-region egress during failover.
Miguel (Security): Checklist for procurement/security: 1) IP ownership statement (we can provide); 2) SLA: we can guarantee 99.9% regional connector availability, higher requires multi-connectors/region; 3) IP abuse/incidents: customer must accept terms for reserved IPs; 4) KMS: support for customer-managed KMS in Private.
Priya (AE): Any sample firewall snippet I can paste?
Nate (NetEng): Paste and tell them to replace PLACEHOLDERS with assigned /32s:
```
# Customer firewall - outbound to Redwood Private connectors
ALLOW TCP 443 to REPLACE_EU_WEST_1_IP/32   # eu-west-1 connector
ALLOW TCP 443 to REPLACE_AP_SOUTHEAST_1_IP/32  # ap-southeast-1 connector
# Optional monitoring/health
ALLOW TCP 443 to 198.51.100.45/32   # redwood monitoring probe (example)
```
Priya (AE): Pricing bullets to include in the quote?
Hannah (Solutions): Use these bullets: - Private deployment license (per-region). - Reserved egress IPs: per-IP monthly surcharge + one-time provisioning fee (enterprise add-on). - SLA: standard 99.9% per-region; recommend 2 connectors/region for 99.95%+. - Professional services: if customer wants Redwood-managed NAT64 or custom IPv6 fronting, that is PS and adds lead time.
Miguel (Security): Also mention logs: audit logs exported to customer S3 for 90 days by default; longer retention available as paid option. We'll provide SOC2 artifacts under NDA.
Priya (AE): Lead time?
Nate (NetEng): IP allocation + legal: ~5-10 business days. Provisioning reserved connectors: ~1-3 weeks depending on capacity. Add PS time if they need custom networking (NAT64/proxy).
ops-bot: Ticket created: POC-9421 Reserved EIP + Security questionnaire task.
Hannah (Solutions): Actions: @Priya confirm whether they will allow cross-region egress during failover; @Nate prepare cost estimate for two /32s (per region); @Miguel draft short answers for their security questionnaire.
Priya (AE): I'll get back with their decision on failover. Thanks all :thumbsup:
